member.name: T:MPTSaveSpectrumLibrary.SaveSpectrumUIHelper
member.summary: Provides UI automation methods for launching and interacting with the Tec5.MPT.Shell spectroscopy application.

member.name: M:MPTSaveSpectrumLibrary.SaveSpectrumUIHelper.StartProgram
member.summary: Starts the spectroscopy program and waits until it is ready.
member.returns: True if the program is successfully started and ready; otherwise, false.

member.name: M:MPTSaveSpectrumLibrary.SaveSpectrumUIHelper.GetProgramId
member.summary: Gets the process ID of the running spectroscopy program.
member.returns: The process ID of the spectroscopy program if found; otherwise, 0.

member.name: M:MPTSaveSpectrumLibrary.SaveSpectrumUIHelper.GetProgramElement
member.summary: Retrieves the main AutomationElement of the spectroscopy program based on its process ID.

member.name: M:MPTSaveSpectrumLibrary.SaveSpectrumUIHelper.StartMonitoringMeasurement
member.summary: Monitors the measurement process in the spectroscopy application.

member.name: M:MPTSaveSpectrumLibrary.SaveSpectrumUIHelper.RestartProgram
member.summary: Terminates the spectroscopy program and restarts it after a short delay.

member.name: M:MPTSaveSpectrumLibrary.SaveSpectrumUIHelper.FindLoginWindow(System.String)
member.summary: Attempts to find and interact with the login window of the spectroscopy program using the given password.
member.param: The password to input in the login dialog.
member.returns: True if login was successful or not needed; otherwise, false.

member.name: M:MPTSaveSpectrumLibrary.SaveSpectrumUIHelper.IsReady(System.Int32)
member.summary: Determines whether the application's UI is ready for user interaction.
member.param: The process ID of the application's main window.
member.returns: True if the application is ready; otherwise, false.

member.name: M:MPTSaveSpectrumLibrary.SaveSpectrumUIHelper.LoggedIn(System.Windows.Automation.AutomationElement)
member.summary: Checks if a user is logged in by detecting a Logout menu item.
member.param: The main AutomationElement representing the application window.
member.returns: True if the user is logged in; otherwise, false.

member.name: M:MPTSaveSpectrumLibrary.SaveSpectrumUIHelper.ConnectDevice(System.Int32)
member.summary: Connects the application to a spectroscopy device if not already connected.
member.param: The process ID of the application's main window.

member.name: M:MPTSaveSpectrumLibrary.SaveSpectrumUIHelper.ConnectToDeviceWindow(System.Windows.Automation.AutomationElement)
member.summary: Identifies and clicks the Connect button inside the "Connect - tecSaaS" dialog window.
member.param: The main AutomationElement of the application.

member.name: M:MPTSaveSpectrumLibrary.SaveSpectrumUIHelper.ConnectionContinue(System.Windows.Automation.AutomationElement)
member.summary: Closes the connection confirmation dialog if it appears.
member.param: The main AutomationElement of the application.

member.name: M:MPTSaveSpectrumLibrary.SaveSpectrumUIHelper.ClickConnectButton(System.Windows.Automation.AutomationElement)
member.summary: Clicks the appropriate Connect button located within the toolbar of the main application.
member.param: The main AutomationElement of the application.

member.name: M:MPTSaveSpectrumLibrary.SaveSpectrumUIHelper.IsProgramRunning(System.String)
member.summary: Determines whether a program with the specified name is currently running and ensures only one instance remains.
member.param: The name of the application process (e.g., "Tec5.MPT.Shell").
member.returns: True if the application is running; otherwise, false.

member.name: M:MPTSaveSpectrumLibrary.SaveSpectrumUIHelper.ClickControl(System.Int32,System.String,System.String)
member.summary: Clicks a UI control element based on a specified property name and value within a window.

The name of the property to match (e.g., "name", "classname", "automationid").
The value of the property to look for.

member.summary: Finds the "Save As" dialog that is a child of the application's main window.
member.param: The main AutomationElement representing the application's window.
member.returns: The AutomationElement for the Save As dialog if found; otherwise, null.

member.summary: Fills out the Save As dialog with the desired file name and file type selection.

The full file path where the file should be saved.

member.name: M:MPTSaveSpectrumLibrary.SaveSpectrumUIHelper.GetProcessIdByName(System.String)
member.summary: Gets the process ID of the first instance of a process with the specified name.
member.param: The name of the process to search for.
member.returns: The process ID if found; otherwise, -1.

member.name: M:MPTSaveSpectrumLibrary.SaveSpectrumUIHelper.ForceGC
member.summary: Forces the .NET garbage collector to run immediately and clean up finalized objects. Use this in long-running processes or when interop memory pressure is a concern.

member.name: M:MPTSaveSpectrumLibrary.SaveSpectrumUIHelper.CloseSaveAsDialogs
member.summary: Closes all open "Save As" dialog windows on the desktop by locating them through UI Automation and invoking their close buttons.
member.remarks: This method uses UI Automation to find top-level windows with the name "Save As" and attempts to invoke the "Close" button on each of them, effectively closing the dialogs if they are found.
member.exception: Thrown if the close button exists but does not support the pattern.

member.name: M:MPTSaveSpectrumLibrary.SaveSpectrumUIHelper.IsMacroHealthy
member.summary: Determines whether the macro is operating in a healthy state by checking the number of open "Save As" dialog windows.
member.returns: true if one or no "Save As" windows are open; otherwise, false.
member.remarks: This method queries the top-level windows and counts how many have the name "Save As". If more than one such window is open, it is assumed the macro may be malfunctioning (e.g., repeatedly triggering the "Save As" dialog).

member.name: T:MPTSaveSpectrumLibrary.WindowForceCloser
member.summary: Provides helper methods to forcefully close windows based on their title, associated process ID (PID), or known UI patterns such as Save As dialogs. Useful for recovering from UI automation deadlocks or leaks.

member.name: M:MPTSaveSpectrumLibrary.WindowForceCloser.ForceCloseSaveAsDialogs
member.summary: Attempts to find and force-close a window titled "Save As" using the WM_CLOSE message. This is useful in UI automation recovery when Save As dialogs become unresponsive or multiply unexpectedly.

member.name: M:MPTSaveSpectrumLibrary.WindowForceCloser.ForceCloseWindowsByPid(System.Int32)
member.summary: Forcefully closes all top-level windows belonging to the specified process ID (PID). Useful for terminating dialog boxes or application windows created by a specific process.
member.param: The PID of the process whose windows should be closed.

member.name: M:MPTSaveSpectrumLibrary.WindowForceCloser.GetTopLevelWindowsForPid(System.Int32)
member.summary: Enumerates all top-level windows for a specific process ID.
member.returns: List of window handles belonging to the process.
